reason: The rule suggests that defining IRS and Customs in relation to compliance assessments leads to promoting accountability. However, if the definitions are not aligned with the actual practices or if there are gaps in compliance, this could contradict the conclusion of promoting accountability.
refined_position: Misalignment of definitions and practices undermines accountability in compliance assessments.
reflecting_rules: - 1. Q[IRS, compliance_assessments](defines(IRS, compliance_assessments) ∧ defines(Customs, compliance_assessments) → promotes(IRS, accountability, compliance_assessments))
